description:
Rhino Wrap Breather is a Class 4 vapour permeable, Light Duty
flexible building membrane engineered for external walls. Manufactured by
laminating a microporous film between two layers of spunbonded non-woven
polyolefin, it allows internal water vapour to escape while acting as an
effective barrier to liquid water, draughts, and dust. It is designed to reduce
the risk of interstitial condensation in residential and commercial timber and
steel-framed wall assemblies.
features:
Class 4 vapour permeable allowing
water vapour to diffuse outward

Triple-layer spunbonded polyolefin and
microporous film laminate

Effective water barrier resisting liquid water
penetration
Air barrier reduces draughts and convective heat loss

Light
Duty mechanical classification to AS/NZS 4200.1

Resistant to mould and
bacterial degradation

Suitable for timber and steel framed wall
construction
Non-reflective surface eliminates installer glare on site

Low
Flammability Index compliant with AS 1530.2
fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable for external walls in
bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 to AS 3959
compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC 2022 Volume One
and Two
sustainability:
100% recyclable polyolefin materials; zero ODP;
non-toxic
install:
Install horizontally on the outer face of timber or
steel wall studs starting from the bottom plate

Fasten with broad-headed
galvanised clouts or staples at maximum 300mm centres

Ensure upper runs
overlap lower runs by at least 150mm to shed water downward

Overlap vertical
joins by minimum 150mm over a stud line

Tape all horizontal and vertical
joins using approved vapour-permeable acrylic cloth tape

Seal around window
and door openings and all service penetrations

Provide a ventilated drainage
cavity between the membrane and exterior cladding

external cladding type requires a drained cavity

Calculate total wall area
allowing minimum 150mm overlaps

tape is specified

rag_summary:
Rhino Breathable Membrane (Rhino Wrap Breather) is
a Class 4 vapour-permeable, Light Duty pliable building membrane manufactured
from non-woven spunbonded polyolefin with a microporous core. Designed for
timber and steel-framed external walls, it allows interior moisture vapour to
diffuse freely while acting as a barrier against wind-driven rain, dust, and
draughts. Compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1:2017 and possessing a Flammability Index
≤ 5 (BAL-40 suitable), it mitigates condensation and mould in residential and
commercial wall assemblies.

description:
Rhino Wrap Breather is a micro-perforated or permeable
reflective foil laminate engineered for external wall and building applications.
Combining high-tensile polypropylene woven scrim with a pure aluminium
reflective surface, it reflects radiant heat while micro-perforations permit
moisture vapour diffusion. It serves as a weather barrier and radiant heat
reflector across framed external walls in warm and temperate Australian climate
zones.

rag_summary:
Misc Tape Metalised represents metalised
polypropylene or aluminium foil pressure-sensitive tapes widely used in
Australian construction for joining and sealing reflective insulation, roof
sarking, and ductwork. Coated with aggressive acrylic or synthetic rubber
adhesives, these tapes create continuous moisture-tight and airtight seals
across membrane laps and penetrations. By preventing convective thermal bypass
and moisture ingress, they maintain system R-values and vapour barrier integrity
across roofs, walls, and HVAC systems.

description:
TensorGrip is an advanced range of industrial canister and aerosol contact
adhesive systems engineered by Quin Global for bonding insulation, foams,
composite panels, and building materials. Designed for high-speed spray
application, TensorGrip adhesives deliver rapid tack, high green strength, and
exceptional heat resistance across wood, metal, concrete, and plastic
substrates. The canister delivery system eliminates the need for external
compressors and reduces application time compared to traditional wet-applied
glues.
features:
High-speed canister spray delivery system with zero
setup time

Rapid flash-off and instant high green tack for immediate
bonding

High heat resistance withstanding extreme Australian cavity
temperatures

Strong adhesion to concrete, brick, plywood, metal, and
insulation cores
Low VOC and non-chlorinated formulation options available
Even spray pattern minimizes adhesive telegraphing on thin facings

Portable,
pressurized canisters eliminate compressor maintenance

High coverage
efficiency reducing cost per square meter

Ensure both
bonding surfaces are clean, dry, and free of grease, dust, and contaminants
Connect spray hose and gun securely to canister and open valve completely
Hold spray gun 100mm to 200mm from surface at 90 degrees

Apply an even,

substrates

Allow adhesive to tack off for 1 to 3 minutes until dry to touch
with no transfer to knuckles

Align materials accurately and press firmly
together

Apply uniform pressure across the entire bond area using a hand-held
pressure roller

Paroc InsulRock
Party Wall Batt represents high-density, non-combustible stone wool (rockwool)
insulation batts engineered for fire and acoustic separation in inter-tenancy
party walls. InsulRock (manufactured using Paroc volcanic rockwool technology
and distributed in Australasia by Fletcher Insulation and regional partners)
provides extreme resistance to shrinkage at temperatures over 1000°C. Meeting
AS 1530.1 non-combustibility and tested for multi-residential FRL compliance, it
controls airborne sound transmission and stops fire spread between adjoining
dwellings.

description:
Paroc Rockwool is a
premium European-engineered stone wool insulation made from volcanic basalt
rock, designed for superior thermal, acoustic, and passive fire protection
across building and industrial applications. Non-combustible with an
exceptionally high melting point exceeding 1000°C, Paroc stone wool does not
shrink, melt, or produce toxic smoke during a fire, maintaining fire
compartmentation. Distributed internationally and used across Australia in
high-performance facades, roofs, and acoustic partitions, it is water repellent,
vapour permeable, and dimensionally stable.

description:
Polyair Reflective is
an Australian-manufactured thermo-reflective insulation range engineered with an
advanced closed-cell polyethylene foam core laminated between pure aluminium
foil facings. Designed for roofs, walls, and sheds in residential and commercial
buildings, it provides a 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and vapour
barrier. By reflecting up to 97% of radiant heat and delivering an in-situ
thermal break, it significantly reduces summer heat gain and prevents winter
heat loss.
